title: Harder Enchanting
description: This mod makes it harder to enchant an item by reducing the bonus 30 experience points you get when enchanting it (fabric required)
body: This mod makes it harder to enchant an item by reducing the bonus 30 experience points you get when enchanting it. If you ask why I made this mod, it is because: Levels like 1-2-3 can be achieved very easily. It is designed to make your servers and worlds longer and more fun. (fabric required)
